description: React Native component for user profile management, including editing name, email, password, and phone number, with integration of GraphQL mutations, navigation, and theming.

methods.name: viewHideAndShowName
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the name editing view.

methods.name: viewHideAndShowEmail
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the email editing view.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful completion of the updateUser mutation, shows a flash message, and navigates back if needed.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates the name input, checks for changes, and triggers mutation if valid.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the user's name via GraphQL mutation if validation passes.

methods.name: handleNamePress
methods.description: Handles the press event to toggle name editing view.

methods.name: handleNamePressUpdate
methods.description: Handles the update process for the name and toggles the view.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors from GraphQL mutation and shows appropriate flash messages.

methods.name: changeNameTab
methods.description: Renders the display view of the user's name.

methods.name: changeEmailTab
methods.description: Renders the display view of the user's email.

methods.name: changePasswordTab
methods.description: Renders the display view of the user's password (masked).

methods.name: changePhoneTab
methods.description: Renders the display view of the user's phone number and verification status.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Sets modal visibility to true for changing password.
